steps.title: Confirm entrepreneur-category eligibility
steps.description: Be 21 to 59, have a Canadian high-school equivalent with a recent ECA, CLB 5, at least $600,000 in transferable assets and qualifying ownership or senior-management experience. Plan to invest at least $200,000 with 33.3 percent ownership, or $1 million in equity, actively manage the eligible business and create a qualifying local job.

steps.title: Complete the exploratory visit and business plan
steps.description: If applying from outside the province, complete the required exploratory visit. Develop a verified plan to start or buy an eligible business; an acquired business generally must have operated under the same owner for five years.

steps.title: Obtain a work permit and operate the business for one year
steps.description: After conditional approval and a Business Performance Agreement, use OIM support to apply for a federal work permit. Move to the province and actively manage the approved business for at least one full year.
